race.comment: SHAPIN POWER (8) returned in good order with a solid runner-up finish on the Poly here and will have derived a stack of benefit from that hit-out. Is yet to miss a drum in three attempts over this sprint journey and maps ideally for this from gate four. Makes plenty of appeal. IL FRATELLO (2) resumes here but has revved up for this with a recent trial and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Can run a big race while fresh. EAGLE'S FIRE (1) was a touch disappointing last time out but the form prior was full of merit. Capable of bouncing right back. KVAS (7) next best with the claim.
